ACME Corporation Reports Third Quarter 2026 Results

For the third quarter of 2026, Segment A revenue was $900 million and Segment B revenue was $600 million,
for total revenue of $1.5 billion.

The company reported non-GAAP diluted earnings per share of $2.00 for the quarter.

Outlook: ACME expects fourth quarter revenue of approximately $1.65 billion.
